name: Chondrocyte (articular cartilage)
failures: Focal defects and diffuse osteoarthritic loss. Avascular, so no repair signal reaches it.

see.note: MRI images cartilage thickness and defects well.

model.note: Hyaline cartilage is a clear target that repair never produces.

reach.note: Avascular: no blood supply to deliver through. Intra-articular injection is the only route.

edit.note: MACI is approved but yields mechanically inferior fibrocartilage, not hyaline.
